title: [SOLVED] everything freezes one by one until the entire system hangs
body: Since several days (probably since last system update - kernel 7.2.2, but not sure) my arch system on Asus GA402R started to strangely hang. Apps starting usually hanging or are killed one by one, eg. firefox is getting unresponsive, then usually lxqt-panel, touchpad left, right click stops working (but I can move pointer) I can switch windows, desktops but can't start any app, qterminal is working and I can run something but after a while everything hangs or stops working until I can't even reboot system. So basically some apps are hanged some not, and it is getting worse within few minutes, it looks similar like there would be out of memory but I have few GB free left. Close before everything dies when I want to run something in terminal, eg. ls, dmesg, reboot I get Input/output error , sometime I get: Call to Reboot failed: Connection timed out I usually can find something in logs or dmesg but this time it is a great mystery for me I run Wayfire + Lxqt daily and restart laptop once per month, usually it is on suspend, swap disabled I have 8GB memory sealed + 32GB added I only run Archlinux on my laptop (no dualboot with windows) What I checked/changed/tested (nothing helped nor changed) - tested on labwc, kde plasma x11 and on wayland, wayfire, openbox - downgraded kernel to 7.1.5.arch1-2 - tested on LTS 6.18.49-1 - checked dmesg, journal - didn't found anything new or worrying (not expert though) - tested on new user and run lxqt and wayfire session - disabled asusd, removed asusctl - checked free space on all partitions - run fsck and checked for bad blocks - memory should be ok, usually run 1-4GB free but this is happening when it's 10-20GB free I didn't run mem check though - It also dies after apps starts freezing and I manage exit Wayfire (ctrl+alt+backspace) to sddm or switch to terminal - disabled sddm and run lxqt from terminal
